title: OpenAEV scenario publish request
description: The staging file .scenario-publish/publish.yaml that the XTM One Publisher agent commits to a scenario-publish/* branch. The scenario-publish Action reads it, exports scenario_id from the author platform, runs intake with request, and removes it before the entry is committed. The platform scenario_id lives here, not in request, because the intake-request schema forbids extra keys.

scenario_id.description: The scenario to export from the author OpenAEV platform: a UUID in lower case with hyphens, as the platform holds it. Not the catalogue external_id.

request.description: The intake request for the exported scenario. Checked in full by intake against schemas/intake-request.schema.json; the required keys are repeated here so a malformed staging file fails before any export.
